reason: A real Blank Knights Shopify import remained queued and the current worker only fetched one page and extracted its title/HTML. The prior example.com smoke validated plumbing but did not validate scraper capability.

scope_statement.goal: Achieve 100 percent correctness and completeness on an explicitly supported scraper acceptance matrix, beginning with Shopify and the Blank Knights live canary, while providing a bounded generic browser fallback and manual-review outcomes for unsupported sites.
scope_statement.not_claimed: This plan does not claim perfect extraction from every arbitrary website on the public internet.
scope_statement.stage_7_boundary: Stage 7 remains paused until this revision is approved, implemented in dependency order, and TICKET-039 evidence passes.

diagnostic_basis: The tested Blank Knights job remained queued because no worker process was claiming it.
The website worker used native fetch for one page and returned title/HTML rather than discovering categories or products.
The existing website normalizer was not connected to the worker execution path.
There was no platform adapter, rendered-browser fallback, recursive pagination, category-selection workflow, or completeness matrix.
Browser screenshot evidence from the earlier repair remained unavailable and is explicitly release blocking in the final validation ticket.

execution_policy.dependency_rule: A ticket may start only when every depends_on_tickets entry is complete and its containing batch is unblocked.
execution_policy.batch_rule: BATCH-010 through BATCH-015 execute in order; only tickets in an explicit execution_waves entry may overlap.
execution_policy.completion_rule: Contract-only tests and example.com smoke are insufficient. User-visible workflow proof, real worker execution, deterministic fixture coverage, controlled live canaries, and browser evidence are required.

golden_fixtures: Saved Shopify collection/product/variant fixtures with pagination and overlapping categories
Generic JavaScript-rendered fixture with cookie overlay, load-more behavior, and bounded scrolling
Restart, timeout, partial failure, unsupported-site, provider-disabled, invalid-AI-output, robots-denial, redirect, and SSRF fixtures
supported_acceptance_matrix.live_canary: Blank Knights Shopify collection, three consecutive controlled runs
supported_acceptance_matrix.required_score: 100 percent of declared expected categories, product URLs, variants, SKUs, prices, images, canonical URLs, provenance, state transitions, and security outcomes

approval_gate.approval_request: Approve REVISION-S5-SCRAPER-REPAIR-2026-08-06 to authorize Stage 6 execution of TICKET-029 through TICKET-039 in BATCH-010 through BATCH-015.
approval_gate.on_rejection_or_revision: Keep all repair tickets awaiting_user_approval and revise this Stage 5 plan without changing implementation code.
